eventMetadata.context_description: Natus Vincere holds a significant edge entering the IEM Atlanta grand final against GamerLegion, driven by their higher world ranking and recent dominance that includes ending Vitality's long top-four streak in the quarterfinals before sweeping BetBoom Team in the semifinals. GamerLegion's younger lineup of Snax, REZ, hypex, Tauson, and PR reached their first notable final in years after resilient comebacks past paiN and Legacy, yet their lower ranking and limited head-to-head success against top-tier opponents highlight the matchup's one-sided nature under current CS2 meta conditions.
